note: FlyBase's undirected memory and learning classes, read as impairments as IMPC's crosswalk reads abnormal spatial working memory; almost every such annotation is a defect

term_names: the memory and learning classes above

less sleep in the fly activity monitor (five minutes of immobility), the measure the fly sleep field uses
more sleep in the fly activity monitor

term_names: increased rate of adult locomotory behavior
note: more adult locomotion; moderate, not strong as in the mouse open field, because the class gathers several assays

term_names: decreased rate of adult locomotory behavior
note: most such annotations come from climbing (negative geotaxis) assays, which measure motor function; never read
more larval or adult swimming (occurrence, velocity, frequency, rate, duration, extent), the zebrafish locomotor readout; the undirected and the process-quality keywords are not read
less swimming; confounded by the developmental, swim-bladder and motor defects of the same fish, so weak
a fish ZFIN records as normal on a locomotor term: an absence on the test that measures the construct, as an open field without a call is for IMPC
more wall-hugging, the zebrafish counterpart of IMPC's increased thigmotaxis
a fish recorded as normal on thigmotaxis: an absence on the anxiety-like readout
more locomotion of C. elegans; a worm has no circuit that corresponds to the human construct beyond motor output, so every worm mapping is its own validity class, off by default
a NOT locomotion variant: locomotion found normal
an associative memory defect of the worm
failure to habituate the light-off jump under pan-neuronal RNAi; habituation is a non-associative form of learning, one narrow part of cognition, so weak rather than moderate
normal habituation: an absence on one narrow test of a broad construct, which decision 9.85 warns against reading; kept weak and off by default for that reason
